phase_name: Flag-Bearing --prune Test Coverage in Both Layouts

objectives.description: Extend classic --prune group (Case group 3, scratch3) with seven flag-bearing cases
Mirror same seven cases into stage --prune group (Phase 5, scratch10)
Assert each surviving line with exact full-line equality; assert all-terminal flagged line absent
Assert pruned=/retained= stderr marker values against hand-computed expectations
Add fail-safe case: non-numeric id token passes through unchanged plus stderr warning
Confirm new cases follow file's pass/fail helper conventions and scratch-directory isolation

deviations.description: During full end-to-end --prune verification, discovered Phase 1's fail-safe warning in prune_next_body() had a bash-quoting bug (embedded literal single quote inside the awk program's single-quoted shell delimiter), corrupting the stderr message.
deviations.reason: Caught via real end-to-end script execution, not visible in the Phase 1 scratchpad harness which happened to use correct quote-escaping when re-typing the function for isolated testing.
deviations.annotation: *(fixed during Phase 3: prune_next_body's fail-safe warning now delimits the bad id with square brackets instead of single quotes)*
